svg.text: All classes, clans with 7+ games. Cell: the clan's value; colour: how far above (blue) or below (orange) the 24-clan average. Clans that sit together play alike.
Blue name = Top 6. Violet = PN (7 games, 14 smokes: small n). W-L beside the name. Distance: 0 = same style as H-SR; the typical gap between two clans is 1.4.
Features are shares of the clan's smokes (%), except smokes per game, median km from smoke edge to the cap, and the median time of the first smoke (seconds).
